## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Oct 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Thorsten Mootz_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "New update is really bad and user unfriendly. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            2. _Harun_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
            3. _Jeannie Ramos_, Oct 4, 2026, 2/5: "I used to love this app, I have a 225ish streak right now, but the bugs are becoming too much, like clicking a food in search to adjust how much i add to the log sometimes exits back to the full day view, its been months of that. also the layout itself keeps changing, often in worse ways. The per meal diary view with specific macros per meal is replaced with a view of the entire day, I cannot access macros per meal anymore bc of it, at least in my free version... redundant and annoying change."
<!--/ir-theme-->
